title: Non-sandboxed Jinja2 environment (SSTI)

patterns.message: jinja2.Environment is NOT sandboxed — rendering model/user-controlled templates (e.g. chat templates) enables SSTI/RCE.

remediation: Use jinja2.sandbox.SandboxedEnvironment for any template whose source or context is untrusted; verify chat-template/tokenizer artifacts before load.
